record.name: Netlify
record.one_liner: Netlify is a hosting and serverless backend platform for the web that provides an API for atomic site deploys, DNS, form submissions, and serverless functions.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free plan and generate personal access tokens or configure OAuth2 applications directly from the dashboard.
record.api_note: The Netlify REST API provides broad coverage for managing sites, deploys, domains, form submissions, environment variables, and functions.

evidence.quote: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS, and so much more.
Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication. All requests must use HTTPS.
Includes usage credits for production deploys, compute, form submissions, bandwidth, and web requests.
Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps
The Netlify MCP Server acts as a bridge, providing API access, CLI tools, prompts, and more for your agents.
You can browse the OpenAPI reference for the Netlify API to explore available endpoints.
